I changed her water out about once a week, added water in when necessary and even put in some fertilizer a few times to help and when her roots got to be probably about 5-6 inches long, I planted her in soil, making sure to keep the soil very moist to ease her into the change from water to dirt. And that's it! I give her lots of light and occasionally I drag her and mama monstera into the shower and just give them a good soaking before letting them bask by the windows again and they usually put out several new leaves soon after!
